item.title: Farah: Why Every Car Should Be a Rally Car
item.description: My recent time in an Aston Martin DBX S has reminded me how annoying intrusive lane-keep systems and huge, lightweight wheels are. In a city full of potholes, I just want a ralli-fied sports car.
